Snapshot index, term, configuration and publication state
external_interfaces: Apply, ApplyLog, Barrier and VerifyLeader futures

ownership: NewRaft assembles caller-provided adapters and starts run, runFSM and runSnapshots unless skipStartup is set.
The main thread owns configuration information requested by takeSnapshot through configurationsCh.
runFSM owns local lastIndex and lastTerm used for snapshot capture.
commitment serializes match-index and commit-index access with a mutex.

The file catalogue also identifies in-memory, discard, cache and network implementation files; their behavior and selection remain unread.

activities.purpose: Reconstruct participant state and restore snapshots.
activities.realization_summary: Initialization-owned restoreSnapshot obtains candidates from the selected SnapshotStore.List and attempts them in returned order. Normal attempts require Open and fsmRestoreAndMeasure to return without error; NoSnapshotRestoreOnStart bypasses both. An accepted attempt precedes application and snapshot coordinate updates and configuration installation. Open or restoration-helper failure advances to another listed candidate; exhaustion of a nonempty list returns an error. Runtime restoration and subsequent resynchronization remain incompletely mapped.

activities.purpose: Reclaim log history through bounded compaction or removal of old stored logs.
activities.realization_summary: Raft computes inclusive deletion ranges and calls the selected LogStore. InmemStore deletes under a mutex; LogCache clears its cache before delegating deletion. This is a partial description of reclamation, not coverage of the full history lifecycle.
